history.overview: The Trial of Weaponry tests combatants’ mastery of weapons, tactical execution, and martial discipline under Discord pressure.

timeline.name: Weaponry Arena Design
timeline.description: Muramite engineers created a trial focused on weapon mastery.

timeline.name: Tactical Platforms Added
timeline.description: Platforms were built to test tactical weapon demonstrations.

timeline.name: Dragorn Weapon Trials

timeline.description: Discord pylons were installed to destabilize improper weapon technique.
